comparison.objective: Set three numbered lock wheels and open a box; candidate tunes a numbered damper collar and locks it.
comparison.physical_skill: Successive wheel rotations and lid opening versus tool-mediated setscrew release, controlled collar adjustment, counterholding, and relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Combination 3-1-7 followed by lid opening at least 60 degrees versus two safe repeatable carriage stops and post-lock drift tolerance.
comparison.reason: Superficial similarity in rotating numbered controls does not reproduce mechanical commissioning or response-driven iteration.
